title: Insertion sort: grow a sorted prefix

steps.caption: Insertion sort: like sorting cards in your hand. The left part (highlighted) is always sorted; take the next card and slide it into place.
Pick up 2. Shift bigger cards in the sorted part one step right to make room.
2 goes to index 0 (1 shifts). Sorted part is now 2 long.
Pick up 4. Shift bigger cards in the sorted part one step right to make room.
4 goes to index 1 (1 shifts). Sorted part is now 3 long.
Pick up 6. Shift bigger cards in the sorted part one step right to make room.
6 goes to index 3 (0 shifts). Sorted part is now 4 long.
Pick up 1. Shift bigger cards in the sorted part one step right to make room.
1 goes to index 0 (4 shifts). Sorted part is now 5 long.
Pick up 3. Shift bigger cards in the sorted part one step right to make room.
3 goes to index 2 (3 shifts). Sorted part is now 6 long.
Done. Worst case O(n²) shifts, but on nearly sorted input almost nothing shifts: close to O(n).
